verdict.rationale: LM Studio's homepage states you can talk to Bionic naturally and your speech gets transcribed in real time. It adds that voice and audio data are processed locally and never leave the device, which covers real-time dictation with on-device processing. A community post confirms Bionic is LM Studio's own app, but the claim rests only on short marketing copy. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the transcription model, setup, languages and accuracy; transcription outside Bionic (main chat app or CLI); independent or hands-on corroboration of the dictation feature.
